risk_summary: The excerpt is generally quantitative and transparent, with detailed year-over-year revenue, expense, cash flow, debt, and restructuring disclosures. Risk is moderate due to a 5.3% revenue decline, an 8.3% GIS decline, reliance on cost reductions, and explicit uncertainty around future financing availability. Liquidity and covenant compliance are presented positively, although the discussion relies partly on non-GAAP metrics and broad forward-looking assurances.
